Name: TC-LOGIN-001 Display merchant login page elements
Objective: Confirm the merchant login page renders all required UI elements for an unauthenticated user.
Precondition: Merchant application is reachable. Tester is logged out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: The login page loads successfully (HTTP 200). Page title includes Login - Sure Bills.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Inspect the page header and helper text.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Heading Start Sending Bills and helper text Please use your credentials to login. are visible.
E-Mail Address input (#email), Password input (#password), Remember Me checkbox, Forgot Your Password? link, Login submit button, and Register a new account2 link are visible.
Sure Bills logo is displayed and a language switcher (عربي or English) is visible.

Name: TC-LOGIN-002 Open login from landing page
Objective: Confirm a visitor can navigate from the public landing page to the merchant login page.
Precondition: Merchant landing page is available. Tester is logged out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Landing page loads.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click the Sign in / Login control in the header (desktop).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is redirected to /login and the login form is displayed.

Name: TC-LOGIN-003 Login page required-field validation when both fields are empty
Objective: Confirm client and server validation block login when email and password are empty.
Precondition: Tester is on /login and is not authenticated.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Fields remain empty.
Login is not completed. Validation errors are shown for required email and required password. User remains on /login.

Name: TC-LOGIN-004 Login page required-field validation when email is empty
Objective: Confirm login is blocked when only password is provided.
Precondition: Tester is on /login and is not authenticated.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Leave Email empty and enter a password.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password field is filled; email is empty.
Validation error is shown for the email field. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-005 Login page required-field validation when password is empty
Objective: Confirm login is blocked when only email is provided.
Precondition: Tester is on /login and is not authenticated.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter a valid-format email and leave Password empty.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Email is filled; password is empty.
Validation error is shown for the password field. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-006 Reject login with unregistered email
Objective: Confirm unknown credentials do not authenticate the user.
Precondition: Tester is on /login. Email is not registered in the merchant database.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an unregistered email and any password.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Values are entered.
User remains on /login and sees These credentials do not match our records. (or Arabic equivalent). User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-007 Reject login with valid email and wrong password
Objective: Confirm a registered merchant cannot log in with an incorrect password.
Precondition: A registered merchant account exists. Tester knows the correct email and an incorrect password.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter the registered email and an incorrect password.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Values are entered.
User remains on /login and sees These credentials do not match our records. Email value is retained (old input). Password is not redisplayed.

Name: TC-LOGIN-008 Successful login when OTP is disabled
Objective: Confirm a merchant with valid credentials is authenticated and redirected home when merchant OTP is disabled.
Precondition: MERCHANT_OTP_ENABLED=false. A valid active merchant account exists. Tester is logged out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login form is displayed.
Credentials are entered.
User is authenticated. Browser is redirected to / (home). Login page is no longer shown.

Name: TC-LOGIN-009 Remember Me keeps merchant session after browser restart
Objective: Confirm the Remember Me checkbox persists the merchant session according to Laravel remember-me behavior.
Precondition: OTP is disabled or already completed. A valid merchant account exists. Browser allows cookies.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: On /login, enter valid credentials and tick Remember Me.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Checkbox is selected.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Login and complete OTP if prompted.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User reaches the authenticated home page.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Close the browser completely and reopen the merchant URL.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is still authenticated and is not forced to the login page.

Name: TC-LOGIN-010 Login without Remember Me does not persist after session cookie expiry
Objective: Confirm that leaving Remember Me unchecked does not create a long-lived remember-me cookie.
Precondition: OTP is disabled or already completed. A valid merchant account exists.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: On /login, enter valid credentials and leave Remember Me unchecked.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Checkbox is not selected.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click Login and complete OTP if prompted.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User reaches home.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Clear the session cookie or close the browser according to test policy, then reopen the app.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is treated as a guest and is redirected to login when accessing a protected page.

Name: TC-LOGIN-011 Password field is masked and can be toggled visible
Objective: Confirm the password input starts as type=password and the eye icon toggles visibility.
Precondition: Tester is on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Characters are masked (input type=password). Eye icon uses ti-eye-off.
Password becomes visible (input type=text) and icon changes to ti-eye.
Password is masked again (type=password) and icon returns to ti-eye-off.

Name: TC-LOGIN-012 Forgot Your Password navigates to password reset request
Objective: Confirm the forgot-password link opens the password reset request page.
Precondition: Route password.request is enabled. Tester is on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is redirected to the password reset request page (password/reset or equivalent password.request route). Login form is no longer the primary view.

Name: TC-LOGIN-013 Register link opens merchant registration
Objective: Confirm a non-member can open registration from the login page.
Precondition: Tester is on /login and is not authenticated.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is redirected to the register page (route register).

Name: TC-LOGIN-014 Switch login page language between English and Arabic
Objective: Confirm the login page language switcher changes locale and text direction.
Precondition: Tester is on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: If the page is in English, click عربي.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Page reloads in Arabic. html dir=rtl. Labels such as login helper text appear in Arabic.
Page reloads in English. html dir=ltr. Labels appear in English.

Name: TC-LOGIN-015 Authenticated merchant cannot reopen the login page
Objective: Confirm guest middleware redirects an already logged-in merchant away from /login.
Precondition: Merchant is already authenticated (OTP completed if enabled).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is redirected away from the login form (typically to /) and is not shown the credentials form.

Name: TC-LOGIN-016 Lockout after too many failed login attempts
Objective: Confirm login throttling after 5 failed attempts, with a 60-minute lockout window.
Precondition: Tester has a registered email. Failed-attempt counter for this email+IP is reset. OTP setting is irrelevant because credentials will be wrong.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Submit invalid credentials 5 times using the same email and IP.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Each attempt shows credentials do not match.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Submit a 6th login attempt (even with the correct password).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login is blocked. Message Too many login attempts. Please try again in :seconds seconds. (or Arabic equivalent) is shown. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-017 CSRF / expired session on login form redirects to login
Objective: Confirm a stale CSRF token does not authenticate the user and returns them to login.
Precondition: Tester is on /login. TokenMismatchException handling redirects to /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open /login and wait until the session/CSRF token is invalid, or submit the form after clearing the session cookie.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Form is stale.
User is redirected to /login and is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-018 Sub-account login is blocked when channel disables sub-account login
Objective: Confirm a user belonging to a channel with disable_login_sub_accounts=true cannot complete login.
Precondition: A merchant user exists whose fromChannel.disable_login_sub_accounts is true. Credentials are otherwise valid.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter the sub-account email and valid password on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Credentials are entered.
Authentication is rolled back. User sees the failed-login message (These credentials do not match our records.) and remains unauthenticated. No OTP page is shown.

Name: TC-LOGIN-019 Valid credentials redirect to OTP when OTP is enabled (email channel)
Objective: Confirm successful first-factor login does not complete the session until OTP is verified, and the email OTP message is shown.
Precondition: MERCHANT_OTP_ENABLED=true. MERCHANT_OTP_CHANNEL=email. Valid merchant account with a reachable email. Tester is logged out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter valid email and password on /login and click Login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Credentials are accepted.
User is redirected to OTP page (Secure Login). Success message: An OTP has been sent to your email. Please enter it to complete login. User is not fully authenticated yet.

Name: TC-LOGIN-020 OTP status message when channel is SMS
Objective: Confirm the OTP page status text matches SMS channel configuration.
Precondition: MERCHANT_OTP_ENABLED=true. MERCHANT_OTP_CHANNEL=sms. Valid merchant with a mobile number.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Redirect to /verify-otp.
Message shown: An OTP has been sent to your mobile number. Please enter it to complete login.

Name: TC-LOGIN-021 OTP status message when channel is both email and SMS
Objective: Confirm the OTP page status text matches both-channel configuration.
Precondition: MERCHANT_OTP_ENABLED=true. MERCHANT_OTP_CHANNEL=both.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Redirect to /verify-otp.
Message shown: An OTP has been sent to your email and mobile number. Please enter it to complete login.

Name: TC-LOGIN-022 Complete login with valid 6-digit OTP
Objective: Confirm a correct OTP completes authentication and lands on the intended home page.
Precondition: OTP is enabled. Tester has just submitted valid credentials and is on /verify-otp. In testing environment OTP is 000000; in production use the received code. OTP is not expired (default 5 minutes).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter the 6-digit OTP in the six boxes.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Each box accepts one digit. Verify button becomes enabled only when all 6 digits are filled.
OTP is accepted. pending_user_id is cleared. User is logged in and redirected to / (or intended URL).

Name: TC-LOGIN-023 Reject invalid OTP
Objective: Confirm an incorrect OTP does not authenticate the merchant.
Precondition: Tester is on /verify-otp with a pending login session. A valid OTP exists that is not the value entered.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Six digits entered; Verify enabled.
User remains on OTP page. Error Invalid OTP. Please try again. is shown. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-024 Reject expired OTP and require a new one
Objective: Confirm an OTP older than the configured expiration cannot complete login.
Precondition: OTP expiration is MERCHANT_OTP_EXPIRATION_MINUTES (default 5). Tester has a pending login and an OTP that has expired.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Wait until the OTP expiry time has passed, then enter the original OTP.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Code is submitted.
Error OTP has expired. Please request a new one. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-025 Resend OTP from the verification page
Objective: Confirm Resend OTP issues a new code and shows the matching success message.
Precondition: Tester is on /verify-otp with a valid pending_user_id. Resend is not throttled yet.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: A new OTP is generated and sent.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Observe the status message for the configured channel.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Email: A new OTP has been sent to your email. SMS: A new OTP has been sent to your mobile number. Both: A new OTP has been sent to your email and mobile number.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter the newly received OTP and verify.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login completes successfully. The previous OTP no longer works if it was superseded.

Name: TC-LOGIN-026 Direct access to OTP page without pending session
Objective: Confirm /verify-otp cannot be used without a pending login.
Precondition: Tester is logged out and session has no pending_user_id.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is redirected to /login with error Your session has expired. Please log in again.

Name: TC-LOGIN-027 Back to Login from OTP page
Objective: Confirm the merchant can abandon OTP and return to the login form.
Precondition: Tester is on /verify-otp after a valid first-factor login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is taken to /login. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-028 OTP Verify button stays disabled until six digits are entered
Objective: Confirm the Verify control cannot be used with a partial OTP.
Precondition: Tester is on /verify-otp.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Verify button is disabled.
Verify button remains disabled. Form does not submit a short OTP.
Verify button becomes enabled.

Name: TC-LOGIN-029 OTP inputs accept digits only and support paste
Objective: Confirm OTP boxes reject non-numeric input and split a pasted 6-digit code across the boxes.
Precondition: Tester is on /verify-otp.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Attempt to type letters or symbols into an OTP box.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Non-digits are not accepted.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Paste a 6-digit code into the OTP wrapper.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Digits are distributed one per box. Hidden otp field becomes 654321. Verify is enabled. Form is not auto-submitted.

Name: TC-LOGIN-030 OTP verify and resend are throttled
Objective: Confirm excessive OTP verify/resend requests are blocked with a friendly error.
Precondition: MERCHANT_OTP_THROTTLE_ATTEMPTS and MERCHANT_OTP_THROTTLE_TIME are configured (defaults 3 attempts / 5 minutes). Tester is on /verify-otp.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Submit Verify or Resend more times than the configured throttle allows.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Further requests are blocked.
Message Too many attempts. Please try again in :minutes minutes. is shown. User is not authenticated.

Name: TC-LOGIN-031 Login form email is retained after failed attempt
Objective: Confirm old('email') behavior after a failed login.
Precondition: Tester is on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Submit a failed login with an email value.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login fails.
Email still shows merchant@example.com. Password field is empty.

Name: TC-LOGIN-032 Login and password fields have autocomplete disabled
Objective: Confirm email and password inputs set autocomplete=off as implemented on the login form.
Precondition: Tester is on /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Both inputs have autocomplete=off. Email has inputmode=email and type=email.

Name: TC-LOGIN-033 Login page is usable on a mobile viewport
Objective: Confirm the login form remains usable on a typical mobile screen.
Precondition: Tester can resize the browser or use a mobile device. User is logged out.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Form fields, Login button, Forgot password, Register link, and language switcher are visible without horizontal overflow that hides required controls.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Complete a valid login (and OTP if enabled).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User can authenticate using the mobile layout.

Name: TC-LOGIN-034 Logout returns merchant to a guest login state
Objective: Confirm logout ends the session and protected pages require login again.
Precondition: Merchant is authenticated.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Trigger logout from the authenticated application.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Session ends.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Open a protected merchant URL then /login.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is treated as guest and can access the login form.

Name: TC-LOGIN-035 Failed OTP send keeps user on login with error
Objective: Confirm the user is not left in a half-authenticated state if OTP delivery fails after valid credentials.
Precondition: OTP is enabled. OTP delivery is forced to fail (e.g. mail/SMS provider error). Valid merchant credentials exist.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: First-factor credentials are valid.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Observe the result when OTP sending fails.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is returned to the login page with Failed to send OTP. Please try again. User is not authenticated and is not on /verify-otp as a logged-in user.
